messages:
Riley M: Postmortem up for the metering gap on 2026-03-18..19. Need owners for backfill, invoice fixes, and monitoring. https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-gap
June P: Quick scan shows ~47 affected PAYG accounts, ~1.1M tokens. I'll take customer comms and invoice updates.
Oscar V: I'll own the backfill and validation. Plan: deploy consumer patch tomorrow morning, staging dry-run same day, prod backfill the day after. ETA CSV of deltas by 2026-04-02.
Tess H: I'll add an alert for late-arriving events and bake a weekly sweep for 6 weeks post-fix. PR to monitoring by 2026-03-31.
Riley M: Assigning owners/dates: backfill + deltas CSV -> Oscar V -> 2026-04-02; invoice corrections & emails -> June P -> 2026-04-05; monitoring PR + sweep -> Tess H -> 2026-03-31; accounting sign-off -> Riley M -> 2026-04-06.
billing-bot: JIRA-4999 created: "Metering gap 2026-03-18..19". Labels: billing, backfill, monitoring.
June P: Requesting CSV format: account_id, period_start, period_end, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd. Oscar pls include a sample diff.
Oscar V: Will attach CSV + top-10 diff in JIRA-4999. Noted dedupe/archival risk.
Riley M: Status check 2026-04-03 09:30 PT in #finance. If blockers, escalate to me. :thumbsup:
